title.purpose: Panel headers and the Quode wordmark. Quiet — 15px / 600. Never display-size.

body.purpose: Chat prose, button labels, output text. Geist 14px / 1.55 with cv02/03/04/11 features.

label.purpose: Uppercase captions: TRY ASKING, runner badges, meta. 10px / 500 / +0.06em tracking.

code.purpose: Editor (Monaco), inline code, stdin, output body. Geist Mono 13px / 1.55.

shadows.name: action-glow
shadows.purpose: Run button only. Inset highlight + warm halo.

shadows.name: backdrop-blur
shadows.purpose: Sticky header and output drawer. Lets the page's ambient gradient bleed through.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions — quartic ease-out, no bounce.

motion.name: duration-quick
motion.purpose: Background, color, and border transitions on hover.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Tab activation, drawer open/close, message appearance.

motion.name: spring-press
motion.purpose: Tactile press on the Run button (motion/react).

components.name: Primary Button (Run)
components.description: The only loud action surface. Used for Run.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px 0 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; background: #ff8c42; color: #1a0d00; font: 500 13px/1 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.25) inset, 0 4px 14px -4px rgba(255,140,66,0.55); transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary__kbd { margin-left: 2px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.15); font: 500 10px/1 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Every secondary control: language picker, input toggle, theme toggle.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #6b541a; font: 500 12px/1 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f9e9a8; color: #2b1f02; }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Inline tab chip. Active is filled; inactive is transparent. Double-click to rename.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #6b541a; font: 400 12px/1 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(249,233,168,0.4); color: #2b1f02; } .ds-tab--active { background: #f9e9a8; color: #2b1f02; } .ds-tab__close { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 4px; color: #957c34; transition: background 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-tab__close:hover { background: #f0d97e; color: #2b1f02; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Vellum-surface input with brand focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #d9be65; background: #fef7d4; color: #2b1f02; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #957c34; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff8c42; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 10px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Generic content container — Vellum surface, Spine Thread border, 14px radius.
components.html:
Output
All quiet. Hit ⌘↵ to run.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid #d9be65; background: #fef7d4; color: #2b1f02; font: 400 14px/1.55 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card__label { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f9e9a8; color: #6b541a; font: 500 10px/1 'Geist', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-card__body { color: #2b1f02; } .ds-card__body kbd { padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: #f9e9a8; font: 400 11px/1 'Geist Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill label for runner badges, suggestion buttons, meta tags.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f9e9a8; color: #6b541a; font: 500 11px/1 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Duck Mascot (Idle)
components.description: Small Lectern Gold mark used in three places only: empty state, panel header, favicon.

narrative.overview: Quode is a warm reading room with a single lamp on. Tall windows let in late-afternoon light that saturates the cream paper, the bound page, the gilt edge of a shelf. The user is at a long table with their laptop open, a notebook beside them, and a patient mentor seated across the room who answers when asked and otherwise lets them read. The interface is the room around the work, not a control panel. The system explicitly rejects the cluttered toolbars of Replit and the bubble-and-name-tag of generic AI chatbots. The Run button is the only loud voice in the room.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper backgrounds, warm brown ink, occasional gold for moments of attention
One primary action surface (Run); all other controls are ghost-weight at rest
Generous radii on everything (6 / 10 / 14px) — nothing looks cut from sheet metal
Flat by default; elevation reserved for the Run button and modal focus
Typography pairs Geist Sans (UI) with Geist Mono (code) — both warm, both modern

rules.name: The One Loud Voice Rule
rules.body: Margin Marker (#ff8c42) appears in at most one surface on screen — the Run button — plus the optional 6×6px dot that indicates stdin content. Any other use of orange is a mistake.

rules.name: The Warm Black Rule
rules.body: Black is forbidden. Where pure black would normally appear, use the tinted neutrals. The reading room is never sterile.

rules.name: The Selection-as-Brand Rule
rules.body: Light mode selection is Margin Marker. Dark mode selection is Lectern Gold. The user's act of selecting text is the moment the brand greets them most directly.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Two fonts only: Geist for UI, Geist Mono for code. No third font for headers, no system fallback for branded copy, no Inter for neutrality.

rules.name: The No-Display-Size Rule
rules.body: Nothing larger than 15px in normal app chrome. Headers earn weight, not size.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels, drawers, tabs, inputs, and ghost buttons are flat. They use background tint and border, never box-shadow. The only element with a real shadow in the entire app is the Run button.

rules.name: The No-Floating-Cards Rule
rules.body: No element hovers above the page with a generic drop shadow. If something needs to feel raised, raise it with tonal layering and a defined border.

dos: Do use Margin Marker (#ff8c42) exclusively for the Run button and the stdin-content dot.
Do layer surfaces tonally — Reading Room Cream → Vellum → Bound Page — to suggest depth without shadows.
Do keep every neutral warm-tinted. Black is forbidden; pure white is forbidden.
Do size text quietly. Geist 14px body, 15px title, 10px uppercase label. Nothing larger in app chrome.
Do use the 6 / 10 / 14 / 999 radius scale consistently.
Do keep no more than five interactive controls in the header bar.
Do let typography and surface tint carry the visual hierarchy.
donts: Don't make the UI look like Replit. No toolbars on every edge, no badge wall, no settings cog parade.
Don't make Duck look like a generic AI chatbot. No model name badge, no token meter, no avatar circle next to every message.
Don't use pure black (#000) or pure white (#fff) anywhere.
Don't use box-shadow on cards, tabs, panels, drawers, or any secondary surface.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left ≥ 2px as a colored accent).
Don't stack rounded corners that fight (e.g. a 14px card containing a 16px input).
Don't introduce a second mono font for design flavor.
Don't size anything in the header above 15px.
